tools.name: search
tools.description: Search live English-teaching jobs in South Korea on LucyESL with a plain-language query. Words for a region, student age, housing, schedule, visa or direct hire are read as filters. Returns up to 20 matches, each an id, a title with the employer, and the listing URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one live LucyESL job listing by its id as a document with its title, its URL and a plain-text body giving the employer, pay, hours, housing, visas, benefits, dates and the facts the advert left unstated. An id that has closed or expired returns an error naming it.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Filter the live LucyESL board of English-teaching jobs in South Korea: region, student age, housing, visa, schedule, contract, setting, direct hire, minimum salary, free text. tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one live LucyESL job listing by its numeric id as a structured record: employer and employer type, region, pay in KRW, teaching and on-site hours, housing, visas, benefits, contract length, start date, dates, and the facts the advert left unstated (null means not stated). tools.name: salary_stats
tools.description: English-teacher salary statistics for South Korea computed from the live listings: median, quartiles, by region, by employer type, effective pay per teaching hour, disclosure rates, housing. Each median comes with the number of adverts behind it. CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: disclosure_stats
tools.description: How many live Korean ESL job adverts state the salary, hours, severance, pension, insurance, airfare, vacation and split shifts: for each, the number that state it, out of how many, and the percentage. CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Live English-teaching job adverts in South Korea counted by region: how many in each, direct hire against recruiters, how many state total on-site hours, and the median advertised salary where the sample allows. Counts of adverts, not of employers. CC BY 4.0.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
